query: Who won the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize?
answer: María Corina Machado, the Venezuelan opposition leader, won the 2025 Nobel Peace Prize. The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced it in Oslo on October 10, 2025. It honoured her work for democratic rights in Venezuela and her push for a peaceful move from dictatorship to democracy [1][2]. A lot of the coverage pointed out that the committee passed over US President Donald Trump, who had openly campaigned for the prize [2][3].
